# Spec: shipped-plugins

Project: dsh-kit

## shipped-plugins.adapter-is-the-only-harness-edge

The tool adapter is the only module allowed to import the harness, and a module added later cannot escape the boundary by not being named.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0001 (approved by 0008)
- checks:
  - command: run: node --test scripts/test-ratchet.mjs

## shipped-plugins.consent-is-hash-bound

An approval puts a decision into force only while the decision still hashes to the text the approval recorded, so editing an approved record voids the consent instead of inheriting it.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0010 (approved by 0011)
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-gate-invariants.mjs (contains "gate invariants ok")

## shipped-plugins.consent-travels-the-human-channel

A ratification question reaches the human through the harness user-questions channel carrying the record's own text, and its answer is derived from a selected label rather than interpreted.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0010 (approved by 0011)
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-gate-invariants.mjs (contains "gate invariants ok")

## shipped-plugins.judge-is-injected

A capability the harness provides reaches a logic module as an injected function, so the module remains testable without a deployment.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0001 (approved by 0008)
- checks:
  - required_text: spawnJudge
  - required_text_glob: never imports the harness

## shipped-plugins.laws-cannot-leave-force-silently

A law that was in force and is no longer compiled is reported unless an active record removes it by id, so a constraint cannot be deleted without a decision that names it.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0012 (approved by 0013)
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-gate-invariants.mjs

## shipped-plugins.laws-stay-inside-their-declared-authority

A record's law whose positive check paths fall outside the union of the zones that record declares is refused, because declaring a less restricted zone must not grant authority over a path the manifest reserves.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0012 (approved by 0013)
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-gate-invariants.mjs

## shipped-plugins.no-harness-import-in-logic

No file under the ratchet plugin may import the harness except its tool adapter, ratchet-tools.mjs.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0001 (approved by 0008)
- checks:
  - forbidden_text_glob: @deepseek-ai/(dsh-tools|cordis)

## shipped-plugins.no-shell-mint

No shell command mints a consent and no tool argument accepts a caller-composed answer; the CLI can only report which decisions are waiting for a human, and it reports the ones it cannot ratify with the reason.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0010 (approved by 0011)
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-consent-surface.mjs (contains "consent surface ok")

## shipped-plugins.specs-cannot-drift-silently

A generated spec document that no longer matches the decision it was compiled from, or that is missing while the project tracks generated specs, is reported by verify, and so is a compile that persists a bundle without regenerating the document, so a green verify cannot coexist with a stale human-readable view of the laws.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0012 (approved by 0013)
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-gate-invariants.mjs

## shipped-plugins.the-authority-table-cannot-be-relaxed-silently

The manifest's zone table decides which paths a human reserves, so a change to a reservation is visible to the gate rather than silent, and the deployment-rules zone still declares humanOnly authority.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0012 (approved by 0013)
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-consent-surface.mjs

## shipped-plugins.unenforced-laws-are-reported

A law in force that declares no check and does not say why is reported as unenforced, because a rule with no enforcement point is an unverified claim.

- authority: agent
- decided in: 0010 (approved by 0011)
- checks:
  - command: run: node scripts/check-gate-invariants.mjs (contains "gate invariants ok")
